parts.text: Some people become successful before they make any money.
At first, it looks like failure.
They start. They fail. People laugh.
Everyone says: get a real job.
And at three in the morning, they lie awake and doubt everything.
Money is not the success. Money is just the receipt.
Real success starts the day you show up, even when nothing pays yet.
Same time. Same work. Every single day.
Pick one thing and do it daily, even when nobody is watching.
Because one day, the results catch up with who you became.
Everything else is just the receipt.
